name: shadow
description: Understand what is moving, what matters, and what should happen next.

interface.shortDescription: Keep ambitious work moving across chats.
interface.longDescription: Shadow turns rough intent and current work into a plain-language brief, decisions, risks, and a credible next move. Without local board access it stays a coach and never pretends to see current work.
defaultPrompt: What is moving, what is stalled, and what needs me?
Turn this rough idea into one durable goal and a clear next move.
Explain this project like a chief of staff, without developer shorthand.
